## Description

Compare predictions from the QNMs v. quantitative MSE. Produce comparison tables needed to create manuscript figures / tables, and some preliminary figures to explore results.

At the end of the script, explore the effect of our "equivocal" threshold (set to 60%) on the number of false positives / false negatives predicted by the QNMs.

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(here)
library(tidyverse)
library(magrittr)
library(ggplot2)
library(QPress)
library(janitor)
library(kableExtra)

## custom functions
source(here('R/fxns/compare.models.MSEtable.R'))

## read in which version of the data from qpress?
sim.date <- '20240923'

## save output to files?
write_out <- FALSE
```



## Data

### qnm

The QNM table is from script 02
```{r}
qnm <- read_csv(here('data','results',paste0('qnm0-5_hcra-e_pSims_',sim.date,'.csv'))) %>% clean_names()
```

fix the operating model scenario numbers. 
```{r}
qnm %<>% mutate(code=case_when(
  grepl('2-',code)~str_replace(code,'2-','1-'),
  grepl('3-',code)~str_replace(code,'3-','2-'),
  grepl('4-',code)~str_replace(code,'4-','3-'),
  grepl('5-',code)~str_replace(code,'5-','4-'),.default=code
))
qnm %<>% mutate(operating_model=case_when(
  grepl('2.',operating_model)~str_replace(operating_model,'2.','1.'),
  grepl('3.',operating_model)~str_replace(operating_model,'3.','2.'),
  grepl('4.',operating_model)~str_replace(operating_model,'4.','3.'),
  grepl('5.',operating_model)~str_replace(operating_model,'5.','4.'),.default=operating_model
))
```


### mse

First time running the script? We need to clean up a little and re-format the original MSE output table.
```{r eval=FALSE}
mse <- read_csv(here('data','mse_out','qMSE_0_1_Ricker_20260821.csv')) %>% clean_names()
mse_column_key <- data.frame(mse_column=c("total_c","cat_fl1","cat_fl2","ssb_ssb",
                                          "eff_fl1","eff_fl2"),
                             new_name=c("total_catch","fishery_1_catch","fishery_2_catch","spawning_biomass",
                                        "fishery_1_effort","fishery_2_effort"))

# clean up MSE output table
# mse %<>% mutate(trial=str_replace(trial,'Results//Resu',''))
mse %<>% mutate(trial=str_replace(label,'Resu',''))
mse %<>% mutate(trial=str_replace(trial,'.out',''))
mse %<>% separate(col='trial',into=c('tmp1','tmp2','tmp3','tmp4'), sep='') %>%
  unite(tmp2,tmp4,col='code',sep="-") %>% dplyr::select(-tmp1,-tmp3)

mse_format <- mse %>% 
  dplyr::relocate(code, .after=label) %>%
  dplyr::select(-label) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=2:(dim(mse)[2]-1),names_to="variable",values_to="prob") %>%
  mutate(variable=ifelse(grepl("ssb",variable), paste0("ssb_",variable),variable)) %>%
  separate(variable,into=c("v1","v2","col_num"),sep="_") %>%
  filter(!(v2 %in% c('j','a','s'))) %>%  ## ignore adult/juveniles split for now
  filter(!is.na(col_num)) %>%    ## gets rid of column that just lists sim coutn (num_s1)
  mutate(model=ifelse(as.numeric(col_num) < 15, "MSE-Species1","MSE-Species2")) %>%
  unite(v1,v2, col="variable",sep="_") %>%
  left_join(mse_column_key,by=c("variable"="mse_column")) %>%
  dplyr::select(-col_num, -variable) %>% rename(variable_out=new_name)

# get rid of the column with the number of iterations.
mse_format %<>% filter(!is.na(model))
mse_format %<>% filter(!is.na(variable_out))

# re-number the cases
mse_format %<>% mutate(code=case_when(
  grepl('2-',code)~str_replace(code,'2-','1-'),
  grepl('3-',code)~str_replace(code,'3-','2-'),
  grepl('4-',code)~str_replace(code,'4-','3-'),
  grepl('5-',code)~str_replace(code,'5-','4-'),.default=code
))

## save
write_csv(mse_format, here('data','results','table1_mse0-4_species1-2_Ricker_20260819.csv'))

## save for table 1
mse_format %>% 
  mutate(prob=case_when(
    prob < 0 ~ 100+prob,
    .default=prob
  )) %>% pivot_wider(
    names_from=variable_out,values_from=prob
  ) %>%
  write_csv(here('data','results','table1_qnmstyle_mse0-4_hcrb-d_species1-2_Ricker_20260819.csv'))
```

```{r}

```


### compare

melt tables so that they can be combined
```{r eval=FALSE}
qnm %<>% pivot_longer(cols=c(total_catch, fishery_1,fishery_2,spawning_biomass), names_to="variable_out", values_to="psims") %>%
  mutate(model="QNM") %>%
  mutate(variable_out=ifelse(variable_out=="fishery_1","fishery_1_catch",
                             ifelse(variable_out=="fishery_2","fishery_2_catch",variable_out)))

mse1 <- mse_format %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species1") %>%
  filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
  filter(!(code %in% c("0-A","1-A")))

mse2 <- mse_format %>% filter(model=="MSE-Species2") %>%
  filter(variable_out %in% qnm$variable_out) %>%
  filter(!(code %in% c("0-A","1-A")))
```

## Explore mismatches: across OMs

This script mostly produces tables, with figures on separate scripts. but I'll also do some plotting below.

For each variable, look at cases where the direction of change was not a match. then break this down to determine whether the QNM was equivocal (aka, we wouldn't want to make a decision off of the QNM response direction) or not (aka we would make a 'wrong' decision from the QNM response direction).

check: was any output 50/50?
```{r}
any(abs(speciesALL_compare$prob) == 50)
any(abs(speciesALL_compare$psims) == 50)
```

ok, we need to account for 50/50 output (which shouldn't be considered positive/negative) in the QNMs.
```{r}
summarise_mismatches <- speciesALL_compare %>%
  mutate(qnm_direction=ifelse(psims < 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "negative", 
                              ifelse(psims > 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "positive","split")),
         mse_direction=ifelse(prob < 50, "negative","positive")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(psims) < 60, 1,0)) %>%
  mutate(compare_dir=case_when(
    qnm_direction=='split' ~ 'split',
    qnm_direction==mse_direction & qnm_equiv==0 ~ 'match',
    qnm_direction==mse_direction & qnm_equiv==1 ~ 'match - qnm equivocal',
    qnm_direction!=mse_direction & qnm_equiv==0 ~ 'mismatch',
    qnm_direction!=mse_direction & qnm_equiv==1 ~ 'mismatch - qnm equivocal',.default=NA)) %>%
  mutate(mse_equiv= case_when(
    prob < 60 & prob > 50 ~ 1,
    prob > 40 & prob < 50 ~ 1,
    .default=0
  ))

summarise_mismatches %<>% dplyr::select(code,model.y,variable_out,compare_dir, mse_equiv) 
```


mismatches summarized across OMs/HCRs for each variable:
```{r}
out1 <- summarise_mismatches %>% 
  dplyr::select(-mse_equiv) %>%
  # pivot_longer(cols=3:6, names_to="variable",values_to="mismatch_type") %>%
  group_by(model.y,variable_out,compare_dir) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  bind_rows(
    summarise_mismatches %>% 
      # pivot_longer(cols=3:6, names_to="variable",values_to="mismatch_type") %>%
      group_by(model.y,compare_dir) %>%
      summarise(n=n()) %>% mutate(variable_out='all')
  ) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from="compare_dir",values_from="n", values_fill = 0)

#check cases in each row. should be 23
# rowSums(out1[,c(3:6)])

# percent out of 23
out1_pall <- out1 %>%
  adorn_percentages(denominator="row")

# percent out of number of non-equivocal
out1_pcertain <- out1 %>%
  dplyr::select(-contains('equivocal')) %>%
  adorn_percentages(denominator="row")

# percent out of equivocal
out1_pequiv <- out1 %>%
  dplyr::select(model.y, variable_out, contains('equivocal')) %>%
  adorn_percentages(denominator="row")

kbl(out1_pall)
```

Add a list column that saves exactly which OM-HCRs were true mismatches
```{r}
out1_pall %<>%
  left_join(
    summarise_mismatches %>% 
      group_by(model.y,variable_out,compare_dir) %>%
      summarise(mismatch_codes=paste0(code,collapse=", ")) %>%
      filter(compare_dir=='mismatch') %>%
      dplyr::select(model.y,variable_out,mismatch_codes)
  )
```
```{r}
# print as nice table
out1_pall %>%
  mutate(across(match:split, \(x) round(x, digits=3))) %>%
  mutate(across(match:split,  \(x) as.character(x))) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c("match","match - qnm equivocal","mismatch - qnm equivocal","mismatch","split","mismatch_codes"), names_to="Qual v Quant", values_to="tmp_p") %>%
  pivot_wider(id_cols=c("model.y","Qual v Quant"), names_from="variable_out",values_from="tmp_p") %>%
  ungroup() %>% dplyr::select(`Qual v Quant`, total_catch, fishery_1_catch, fishery_2_catch,spawning_biomass, all) %>%
  rename(Total=total_catch, `Fishery 1`=fishery_1_catch, `Fishery 2`=fishery_2_catch, `Spawning Biomass`=spawning_biomass, Overall=all) %>%
    kbl() %>%
    kable_classic_2(full_width = F) %>%
      add_header_above(c(" ", "Catch" = 3, " " = 2)) %>%
  pack_rows("Species 1", 1, 6) %>%
  pack_rows("Species 2", 7, 12)
  
```

## Explore mismatches: Thorson Effort


The Thorson effort quant MSE was run with different values of a parameter. Do quant MSE / QNM results match better at certain values of that parameter?
```{r}
thorson_mismatches <- compareThorson %>%
  mutate(qnm_direction=ifelse(psims < 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "negative", 
                              ifelse(psims > 0 & abs(psims) != 50, "positive","split")),
         mse_direction=ifelse(prob < 50, "negative","positive")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(psims) < 60, 1,0)) %>%
  mutate(compare_dir=case_when(
    qnm_direction=='split' ~ 'split',
    qnm_direction==mse_direction & qnm_equiv==0 ~ 'match',
    qnm_direction==mse_direction & qnm_equiv==1 ~ 'match - qnm equivocal',
    qnm_direction!=mse_direction & qnm_equiv==0 ~ 'mismatch',
    qnm_direction!=mse_direction & qnm_equiv==1 ~ 'mismatch - qnm equivocal',.default=NA)) %>%
  mutate(mse_equiv= case_when(
    prob < 60 & prob > 50 ~ 1,
    prob > 40 & prob < 50 ~ 1,
    .default=0
  )) %>%
  rename(species=model.y) %>% dplyr::select(species,code,mse_code,operating_model, variable_out,compare_dir, mse_equiv) 

thorson_mismatches_summary <- thorson_mismatches %>%
  group_by(species,operating_model,compare_dir) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
```

## Explore mismatches: equivocal QNM

when the QNM was qualitatively *equivocal* ( <60% stable matrices had same response direction), did the direction generally agree with the quant MSE?

"split" = the QNM output was 50/50

"match" = the QNM direction was the same as the MSE direction (+/+ or -/-)

"false positive" = QNM direction positive and qMSE direction negative

"false negative" = QNM direction negative and qMSE direction positive

```{r}
speciesALL_equiv_split <- speciesALL_compare %>%
  filter((psims < 60 & psims > 0) | (psims > -60 & psims < 0))

speciesALL_equiv_split %<>% mutate(match_direction=ifelse(psims==50 | psims==-50,"split",
                                                    ifelse(psims < 0 & prob > 50, "false negative",
                                                    ifelse(psims > 0 & prob < 50, "false positive","match"))))
```

is any qMSE prediction equivocal? recall we're just marking these, not excluding them from results. nope!
```{r}
speciesALL_equiv_split %>% filter(prob < 60 & prob > 40)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
equiv_mismatches_summary <- speciesALL_equiv_split %>% 
  group_by(model.y,variable_out) %>%
  mutate(case_n=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(model.y,variable_out,case_n,match_direction) %>%
  summarise(ndiff=n()) %>%
  mutate(pdiff=round(ndiff/case_n,3)) %>%
  bind_rows(
    speciesALL_equiv_split %>% 
  group_by(model.y) %>%
  mutate(case_n=n()) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
  group_by(model.y,case_n,match_direction) %>%
  summarise(ndiff=n()) %>%
  mutate(pdiff=round(ndiff/case_n,3)) %>% mutate(variable_out='Overall')
  )

equiv_mismatches_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(model.y,variable_out,match_direction,case_n, pdiff) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=match_direction, values_from=pdiff, values_fill=0) %>%
  kbl() %>% kable_paper(full_width=T)
```

write out
```{r}
equiv_mismatches_summary%>%
  dplyr::select(model.y,variable_out,match_direction,case_n, pdiff) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from=match_direction, values_from=pdiff, values_fill=0) %>%
  write_csv(here('data','results',paste0('tblC9_equiv_mismatches_',sim.date,'.csv')))
```

## False positives / negatives

classify mismatches as either false positive or false negative
```{r}
triage_df <- speciesALL_compare  %>%
  dplyr::select(-model.x) %>% rename(species=model.y) %>%
  rename(qnm_psims=psims, mse_prob=prob) %>%
  mutate(species=case_when(
    grepl("Species1", species) ~ "(sp.1) med longevity", 
    grepl("Species2", species) ~ "(sp.2) short lived")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims) < 60, 1, 0),
         mse_equiv=ifelse(mse_prob > 40 & mse_prob < 60, 1, 0)) %>%
  # mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'true negative',
  #                      ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'true positive',
  mutate(triage=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims)==50, 'split',
                       ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'true negative',
                              ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'true positive',
                                     ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'false positive',
                                            ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'false negative', NA)))))) %>%
  #        ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'false positive',
  #               ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
  mutate(triage_noEquiv=ifelse(qnm_equiv==0, triage, NA))
```

## Catch - Biomass Trade-offs

these are the possible trade-offs:
```{r}
tradeoffs_vec <- c("catch increases,\nbiomass increases","catch increases,\nbiomass decreases","catch decreases,\nbiomass increases", "catch decreases,\nbiomass decreases")

## create a pairwise df of all possible trade-offs
pairwise_df <- data.frame(MSE= rep(tradeoffs_vec,each=4),
  QNM=rep(tradeoffs_vec, 4))
pairwise_df %<>% 
  mutate(species="(sp.1) med longevity") %>%
  bind_rows(
    pairwise_df %>% mutate(species="(sp.2) short lived")
  )
```


prepare a df to describe trade-offs. we don't want to use equivocal output to make triage decisions in the main text, so NA-out equivocal QNM output. 
```{r}
tos_equiv <- speciesALL_compare  %>%
  dplyr::select(-model.x) %>%
  rename(qnm_psims=psims, mse_prob=prob, species=model.y) %>%
  mutate(species=case_when(
    species=="MSE-Species1" ~ "(sp.1) med longevity", 
    species=="MSE-Species2" ~ "(sp.2) short lived")) %>%
  mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims) < 60, 1, 0),
         mse_equiv=ifelse(mse_prob > 40 & mse_prob < 60, 1, 0)) 

tos <- tos_equiv %>%
  mutate(qnm_psims=ifelse(qnm_equiv==1, NA, qnm_psims)) 
```


this version of the trade-offs df has "increase" and "decrease" for use in a table.
```{r}
tost_list <- list()
i = 1
for(v in c('total_catch','fishery_1_catch','fishery_2_catch')){
  tmpdat <- tos %>%
    filter(variable_out %in% c(v, "spawning_biomass")) %>%
    mutate(variable_out=case_when(grepl('catch',variable_out) ~ 'catch',.default=variable_out)) %>%
    dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, variable_out, qnm_psims, species) %>%
    pivot_wider(names_from=variable_out, values_from=qnm_psims) %>%
    mutate(QNM=case_when(
      is.na(catch) & spawning_biomass > 0 ~ ' catch, increase biomass', 
      is.na(catch) & spawning_biomass < 0 ~ ' catch, increase biomass', 
      catch > 0 & is.na(spawning_biomass) ~ 'decrease catch,  biomass',
      catch < 0 & is.na(spawning_biomass) ~ 'increase catch,  biomass',
      catch > 0 & spawning_biomass > 0 ~ 'decrease catch, decrease biomass',
      catch < 0 & spawning_biomass > 0 ~ 'increase catch, decrease biomass',
      catch < 0 & spawning_biomass < 0 ~ 'increase catch, increase biomass',
      catch > 0 & spawning_biomass < 0 ~ 'decrease catch, increase biomass', 
      is.na(catch) & is.na(spawning_biomass) ~ ' catch,  biomass'
    )) %>%
    # filter(QNM != ' catch,  biomass') %>%
    dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, species, QNM) %>%
    left_join(
      tos %>%
         filter(variable_out %in% c(v, "spawning_biomass")) %>%
    mutate(variable_out=case_when(grepl('catch',variable_out) ~ 'catch',.default=variable_out)) %>%
        group_by(species,operating_model, management_strategy, code) %>%
        mutate(tot_mse_equiv=sum(mse_equiv)) %>% ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, variable_out, mse_prob, species, tot_mse_equiv) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from=variable_out, values_from=mse_prob) %>%
        mutate(MSE=case_when(
          catch > 50 & spawning_biomass > 50 ~ 'decrease catch, decrease biomass',
          catch < 50 & spawning_biomass > 50 ~ 'increase catch, decrease biomass',
          catch < 50 & spawning_biomass < 50 ~ 'increase catch, increase biomass',
          catch > 50 & spawning_biomass < 50 ~ 'decrease catch, increase biomass'
        ))  %>%
        dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, species, MSE, tot_mse_equiv)

    )
  tost_list[[i]] <- tmpdat
  names(tost_list)[i] <- v
  i = i + 1
}
```


save as an RDS 
```{r}
saveRDS(tost_list, here('data','results','fig7_data_text.rds'))
```

```{r}
        group_by(species,operating_model, management_strategy, code) %>%
        mutate(tot_mse_equiv=sum(mse_equiv)) %>% ungroup() %>%
        dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, variable_out, mse_prob, species, tot_mse_equiv) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from=variable_out, values_from=mse_prob) %>%
        mutate(MSE=case_when(
          catch > 50 & spawning_biomass > 50 ~ '\u2191 catch,\n\u2191 biomass',
          catch < 50 & spawning_biomass > 50 ~ '\u2193 catch,\n\u2191 biomass',
          catch < 50 & spawning_biomass < 50 ~ '\u2193 catch,\n\u2193 biomass',
          catch > 50 & spawning_biomass < 50 ~ '\u2191 catch,\n\u2193 biomass'
        ))  %>%
        dplyr::select(operating_model, management_strategy, code, species, MSE, tot_mse_equiv)

    )
  tos_allqnm_list [[i]] <- tmpdat
  names(tos_allqnm_list )[i] <- v
  i = i + 1
}
```

save as an RDS 
```{r}
saveRDS(tos_allqnm_list , here('data','results',
                               paste0('fig7_data_arrows_countEquiv_',sim.date,'.rds')))
```

use Fig 7 data frame to produce a table for fig c3
```{r}
figs_list <- list()
i = 1
for(v in c('total_catch','fishery_1_catch','fishery_2_catch')){

  figs_list[[i]] <- tos_equiv %>%
    filter(variable_out %in% c(v, "spawning_biomass")) %>%
    mutate(variable_out=case_when(grepl('catch',variable_out) ~ 'catch',.default=variable_out)) %>%
    mutate(QNM=case_when(
      (qnm_psims > 0 & qnm_equiv==0) ~ '+',
      (qnm_psims > 0 & qnm_equiv==1 & qnm_psims != 50) ~ '(+)',
      (qnm_psims < 0 & qnm_equiv==0) ~ '-',
      (qnm_psims < 0 & qnm_equiv==1 & qnm_psims != -50) ~ '(-)',
      abs(qnm_psims)==50 ~ ''
    )) %>%
    mutate(MSE=case_when(
      (mse_prob > 60) ~ '+',
      (mse_prob > 50) ~ '(+)',
      (mse_prob < 40) ~ '-',
      (mse_prob < 50) ~ '(-)')) %>%
    mutate(qnm_compare=case_when(
      (QNM==MSE | (QNM=="(+)" & MSE=="+") | (QNM=="+" & MSE=="(+)") | (QNM=="(-)" & MSE=="-")) ~ "same", 
      ((QNM=="+" | QNM=="(+)" ) & (MSE=="-"  | MSE=="(-)")) ~ "optimistic",
      ((QNM=="-" | QNM=="(-)" ) & (MSE=="+"  | MSE=="(+)")) ~ "pessimistic",
      QNM=="" ~ "50/50"))
  i = i + 1
}

names(figs_list) <- c('total_catch','fishery_1_catch','fishery_2_catch')
```
```{r eval=write_out}
saveRDS(figs_list, file=here('data','results',paste0('figs_tradeoffs_expanded_byOMbyHCRbySp_',sim.date,'.RDS')))
```

use Fig 7 data frame to produce table C6
```{r}
tbl_c6_list <- list()
i = 1
for(v in c('total_catch','fishery_1_catch','fishery_2_catch')){
tbl_c6_list[[i]] <- tos_list[[v]] %>% 
    mutate(MSE=case_when(
      grepl('\u2191',MSE) | grepl('\n\u2191',MSE) ~ str_replace_all(MSE,'\u2191','+'),
      .default=MSE),
    MSE=case_when(
      grepl('\u2193',MSE) | grepl('\n\u2193',MSE) ~ str_replace_all(MSE,'\u2193','-'),
      .default=MSE),
    MSE=case_when(grepl('\n',MSE) ~ str_replace_all(MSE,'\n',' '),
                  .default=MSE)) %>%
    mutate(QNM=case_when(
        grepl('\u2191',QNM) | grepl('\n\u2191',QNM) ~ str_replace_all(QNM,'\u2191','+'),
        .default=QNM),
      QNM=case_when(
        grepl('\u2193',QNM) | grepl('\n\u2193',QNM) ~ str_replace_all(QNM,'\u2193','-'),
        .default=QNM),
      QNM=case_when(grepl('\n',QNM) ~ str_replace_all(QNM,'\n',' '),
                    .default=QNM)) %>%
    mutate(MSE=paste0('"',MSE,'"'), QNM=paste0('"',QNM,'"')) %>%
    mutate(catch_metric=v)
i = i + 1
}

tblc6_out <- do.call(rbind,tbl_c6_list)
```



## Effect of consistency threshold

how does the sign consistency threshold that we use for the QNMs affect the proportion of cases that are labeled as false positive / false negative?

```{r}
speciesALL_compare <- read_csv(here('data','results',paste0('mseVqnm_prob-psim_species1-2_allHCRallOM_',sim.date,'_2026review.csv'))) %>% 
  filter(!is.na(model.y))  ## can't compare A. Status Quo for baseline, thorson effort

to_triage <- speciesALL_compare  %>%
    dplyr::select(-model.x) %>% rename(species=model.y) %>%
    rename(qnm_psims=psims, mse_prob=prob) %>%
    mutate(species=case_when(
      grepl("Species1", species) ~ "(sp.1) med longevity", 
      grepl("Species2", species) ~ "(sp.2) short lived"))
```

```{r}
thresholds <- c(51,seq(55,100,by=5))

tdat <- do.call(rbind, 
                      lapply(thresholds, FUN=function(x){
                        to_triage %>%
                          mutate(qnm_equiv=ifelse(abs(qnm_psims) < x, 1, 0)) %>%
                          # mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'true negative',
                          #                      ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'true positive',
                          mutate(triage=ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'true negative',
                                               ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'true positive',
                                                      ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 50, 'false positive',
                                                             ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 50, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
                          #        ifelse(qnm_psims > 0 & mse_prob < 40, 'false positive',
                          #               ifelse(qnm_psims < 0 & mse_prob > 60, 'false negative', NA))))) %>%
                          mutate(triage_noEquiv=ifelse(qnm_equiv==0, triage, NA)) %>%
                          mutate(threshold=x)
                      })
)
```

how does the proportion of all predictions (n=23 cases x 4 variables) which are categorized as *non-equivocal* false negative / positive change with the threshold?
```{r}
tdat_summary <- tdat %>%
  group_by(threshold,species) %>%
  mutate(total_cases=n()) %>%  # should be 23*4
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(threshold,species,total_cases,triage_noEquiv) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  mutate(p=n/total_cases)

tdat_summary %>% filter(grepl('false',triage_noEquiv)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from=p,names_from=triage_noEquiv, values_fill=0) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('false negative','false positive'), names_to='triage_noEquiv',values_to='p') %>%
ggplot(aes(x=threshold,y=p,col=species))+
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=60),lty=2) +
  facet_wrap(~triage_noEquiv) +
  labs(x='Minimum sign consistency (%)',y='Proportion of predictions') +
  ylim(c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()
```


```{r}
tdat_mismatch_summary <- tdat %>%
  filter(grepl('false',triage)) %>%
  group_by(threshold,species) %>%
  mutate(total_cases=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(threshold,species,total_cases,triage,qnm_equiv) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  mutate(p=n/total_cases)

tdat_mismatch_summary %>%
  dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from=p,names_from=triage, values_fill=0) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('false negative','false positive'), names_to='triage',values_to='p') %>%
  mutate(`QNM equivocal`=as.factor(qnm_equiv)) %>%
ggplot(aes(x=threshold,y=p,col=`QNM equivocal`,pch=species))+
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=60),lty=2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0)) +
  facet_grid(cols=vars(species),rows=vars(triage)) +
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(2,19), guide='none') +
  labs(x='Minimum sign consistency (%)',y='Proportion of mismatched predictions') +
  ylim(c(0,1)) +
  scale_color_manual(values=c('gray20','goldenrod'))+
  theme_bw() -> p2

p2
```



```{r}
tdat_summary_nonequiv <- tdat %>%
  filter(qnm_equiv==0) %>%
  group_by(threshold,species) %>%
  mutate(total_cases=n()) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(threshold,species,total_cases,triage_noEquiv) %>%
  summarise(n=n()) %>%
  mutate(p=n/total_cases)

p1 <- tdat_summary_nonequiv %>% filter(grepl('false',triage_noEquiv)) %>%
  dplyr::select(-n) %>%
  pivot_wider(values_from=p,names_from=triage_noEquiv, values_fill=0) %>%
  pivot_longer(cols=c('false negative','false positive'), names_to='triage_noEquiv',values_to='p') %>%
ggplot(aes(x=threshold,y=p,pch=species))+
  geom_point() +
  geom_path() +
  geom_vline(aes(xintercept=60),lty=2) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept=0)) +
  facet_grid(rows=vars(triage_noEquiv)) + 
  scale_shape_manual(values=c(2,19)) +
  labs(x='Minimum sign consistency (%)',y='Proportion of non-equivocal predictions') +
  ylim(c(0,1)) +
  theme_bw()
p1
```
